payload.body: Fix the journal seq-collision class of bug: concurrent 'nahel log' writes to the same run segment are not serialized, so two writes can both claim the same seq (observed during a codex review run — two distinct events both got seq 3 in nahel/journal/archive/run-8z8dttmy.jsonl). The duplicate was born and committed that way, so validate's 'restore from git' advice cannot work — every git version has it — and validate keeps failing, masking future real errors. Scope: (1) serialize concurrent 'nahel log' appends to a run segment (lock or atomic seq allocation); (2) add a repair verb for a born-duplicate seq, since agents are forbidden from hand-editing the store and the only fix today is a human hand-editing one line (e.g. bumping event kxx08c5r's seq 3 -> 4 and committing); (3) make validate distinguish a born-with-duplicate segment from a corrupted one instead of advising a git restore that will never resolve it.
